
### Which file do I need?

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `indir-windows-setup.exe` installs for you only, with no administrator rights. `indir-windows-portable.exe` runs without installing. |
| macOS 11 or later | `indir-mac.dmg`, for Apple silicon and Intel alike. |
| Linux | `indir-linux-amd64.AppImage` runs anywhere; `.deb` is for Debian, Ubuntu and Mint, `.rpm` for Fedora and openSUSE. |

**The first time you open it:** indir isn't signed with a paid certificate, so your system asks once. On Windows,
if SmartScreen says *Windows protected your PC*, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On macOS, open indir
once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
